title: Cities in ink concept video
description: A 36 second ink-engraving flight across four cities, where a letter folded into a paper plane carries one line of serif type from the Eiffel arch to the top of the Burj Khalifa. Every building, cloud and hatched shadow is drawn in real-time Three.js.
